test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 28 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A train covers a distance of 850 metres in 45 seconds. Travelling at the same speed, how many kilometres will the train cover in an hour?
solution:
**Given:**

Distance covered by the train = 850 metres

Time taken = 45 seconds

**Formula Used:**

Speed in km/hr = 18/5 × speed in m/sec

Distance = speed × time

**Calculation:**

Speed in km/hr = 18/5 × 850/45

⇒ 68 km/hr.

Distance = 68 km/hr × 1hr

⇒ 68 km

**The train will cover 68 kilometres in an hour.**
